look: Prism Archon, a B-rank GKOM variant from the Prism Wardens family: tall floating archon made of a crown of rotating prisms around a core of light. Family anatomy: floating faceted light-spirits and prism sentinels built of rotating crystal plates. Build: large, heavy and imposing. GKOM rank cue: half the body armoured in GKOM crystal, natural patches between the plates; the crystals are green-gold prism crystal. A softball-sized GKOM core orb, dark crimson with a steady pulse, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Light: warm gold, white and soft rose accents, strong sun motes, feather-like light and halo rings
